QuestInfo.name: Stephan the Watchman
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2153000##k, the watchman with sharp eyes. Maybe he knows something about the Black Wing leadership.
QuestInfo.1: #p2153000# really does steal supplies! He's no master thief, but he gets the job done. And boy does he love money! You could try a bribe, but he'll get suspicious. Instead, go eliminate some #r#o2150003##k machines and bring the #b#t4033123##k items they carry.\n\n#i4033123# #t4033123# #b#c4033123# / 40#k
QuestInfo.2: According to #p2153000#, the Black Wings officers are outside of #m310000000# trying to collect something from the mine nearby.

0.0: I don't know what you are trying to get out of me, but I have nothing to tell you. If you want something, pay up. I'm not giving anything away for free.
0.1: You don't have any money? Then bring me items! The #b#t4033123##k is a valuable asset at the right market. Bring me #b40#k and we'll talk.

yes.0: If you were to dismantle the #r#o2150003##k machines, you could take the #t4033123# right out of their circuit boards.

no.0: Have it your way. Just keep away from me.

1.0: You lived up to your end of the bargain. You want to know about the Black Wing officers? I'll tell you...
1.1: To mind your own business! You think you should even be let near one of the commanders? They would tear you apart with their laser beam eyes! That's only a euphemism, but I believe a few of them actually do have laser beam eyes.

yes.0: Take my advice. Scrape together the small remaining fraction of wealth you have and devote yourself to making money. You'll find nothing with the Black Wings.
yes.1: #bYou wouldn't even find an officer or commander near #m310000000# anyway#k. Anyone of any importance is off on their own missions, working to collect resources and artifacts.
yes.2: In fact, the only person you MIGHT have a chance to run into is the founder of the Black Wings! I've heard he or she was working to #bextract a great deal of energy from #m310000000##k, but you'd have more luck finding a fairy under the rocks.
yes.3: If you really want to continue your foolish search, speak to someone higher up, like #bSecretary #p2154002##k. But do not let your guard down for a second. She is no more friendly than a cornered badger.

item.0: Our business will continue when I am holding a stack of #t4033123# items.
